sentences.en: Please refrain from smoking, while the non-smoking signs are on.
sentences.zh: 请勿吸烟，直到非吸烟标志熄灭。

sentences.en: I cannot refrain from expressing my opinion about the affair.
sentences.zh: 我无法抑制住对这件事发表意见。

sentences.en: Please refrain from smoking until the sign is turned off.
sentences.zh: 请在标志熄灭前不要吸烟。
